title: Early SpaceX Investor Backs Tesla Tie-up
text: SpaceX is building the means of production for intelligence, says Chad Anderson, CEO of Space Capital. Anderson, an early investor in SpaceX, explains why he sees the company as a modern version of the vertically integrated giants of the Industrial Revolution, how much room it has to grow, and how the neocloud, connectivity and AI segments all fit into the space business. He speaks with Ed Ludlow on “Bloomberg Tech.” (Source: Bloomberg)
